fields.statement: Acceptance policy decides which change sets are accepted without the owner: with accept auto, change sets an owner-requested plan run proposes are accepted at its gate when its review passes; with accept owner, they wait for the owner

fields.acceptance: daemon-settings.txtar: daemon settings lists every key with its default and source default; daemon set rhiza.daemon.maxRuns 1 then settings shows 1 from git config; an unknown key or bad value exits 2 writing nothing; with maxRuns set to 1 between two daemon --once polls, the second starts at most one run; a --max-runs flag wins over config and settings shows source flag in daemon status; describe-golden.txtar is regenerated
fields.statement: The daemon reads its settings (paused, max runs, minimum free disk, permission mode, and plan, accept, ship and signoff autonomy) from git config every poll, a command-line flag winning for that run; rhiza daemon settings lists each with value and source and rhiza daemon set validates and writes one

fields.acceptance: daemon-pause.txtar: with paused set, daemon --once on a ready change set starts nothing and daemon status shows Paused: yes and each candidate skipped as paused; after setting it false the next --once starts the run
fields.statement: With rhiza.daemon.paused true the daemon starts and resumes no runs but keeps polling, reporting and notifying, and daemon status says paused

fields.acceptance: Testscripts with a fake rex and agents: ship owner leaves a ready change set unstarted with skip reason ship-owner; signoff owner starts run start without --autonomous; accept owner leaves the plan's drafts proposed after an autonomous plan gate and inbox --json lists an accept item for each, while accept auto accepts them
fields.statement: The ship, signoff and accept settings govern the daemon and plan runs: ship owner stops the daemon starting ship runs, signoff owner starts them non-autonomous so they stop at sign-off, accept owner leaves an owner-requested plan's change sets proposed at its gate and the inbox lists each as waiting for acceptance
